figures.finding: Film Estonia, the cash rebate run by the Estonian Film Institute since 2016, was raised from 30% to 40% of spend in Estonia by government decision announced on 8 March 2026, effective about a month later once the regulations were updated; in 2025 it paid EUR 6 million to 12 foreign projects.

figures.finding: Film Estonia's own guidelines (2026) give a cash rebate of up to 40% of eligible Estonian production costs, open at any time with processing in up to 40 days, for feature films budgeted at EUR 1 million or more, feature and short animation at EUR 150,000, animation series at EUR 500,000, scripted TV drama at EUR 100,000 an episode, feature documentaries at EUR 200,000, and their post-production; the 40% intensity applies where at least two creative employees are Estonian tax residents.

value.name: Film Estonia cash rebate
value.creativeStaffRule: 40% if at least 2 creative employees are tax residents of Estonia

sources.said: An application can be made for international production service or co-production to receive a cash rebate up to 40% on eligible production costs. … feature films with a budget of at least € 1 million; feature and short animation with a budget of at least € 150 000; animation series with overall budget of at least € 500 000; scripted TV-drama with a budget of at least € 100 000 per single episode; feature documentary with a budget at least € 200 000; post-production of all the above mentioned works. … multiplied by 30% or 40%. … 40% if at least 2 creative employees are tax residents of Estonia

figures.finding: Under Film Estonia's support scheme as in force from 20 April 2026 (RT I, 17.04.2026, 6), a feature film budgeted at EUR 1,000,000 or more gets 30% of its eligible Estonian costs where they come to EUR 200,000-500,000 and 40% from EUR 500,001; the scheme sets no cap per project, and Film Estonia's 2026 budget is EUR 9,200,000.
figures.applies: Estonia, foreign productions with an Estonian partner, from 2026-04-20.
